sources.title: facebookresearch/deit | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides an introduction to the DeiT (Data-Efficient Image Transformers) repository, which contains multiple vision transformer architectures and related models for image classification tasks. The repository focuses on efficient training techniques and architectural innovations for transformer-based computer vision models.

sources.snippet: Recently, neural networks purely based on attention were shown to address image understanding tasks such as image classification. However, these visual transformers are pre-trained with hundreds of millions of images using an expensive infrastructure, thereby limiting their adoption.
